Opening `/config` in a Windows terminal to check `Rendering Mode` previously often showed false warnings or cut-off descriptions.

When `TERM` was unset in Windows PowerShell or Command Prompt consoles, it used to falsely warn `⚠ terminal does not support alt screen`. That false warning is now fixed.

`Rendering Mode` warnings such as `⚠ alt screen unavailable — run ssh -t` also used to run right into the setting description in dim text. It would also say `terminal "unknown"` when the terminal name was unavailable, and cut off multi-line setting descriptions past three lines; all of these display issues are now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed `/config` showing a false `⚠ terminal does not support alt screen` warning under `Rendering Mode` in Windows PowerShell and Command Prompt consoles when `TERM` is unset.
Fixed `/config` running `Rendering Mode` warnings (such as `⚠ alt screen unavailable — run ssh -t`) into the setting description in dim text, saying `terminal "unknown"` when the terminal name is unavailable, and cutting off multi-line setting descriptions past three lines.

title.zh-TW: agy acp 編輯器載入與回合狀態修好
title.en: agy acp editor loading and turn state fixed

body.zh-TW:
透過 `agy acp` 把寫程式工具接上代理後，過去常碰到對話紀錄讀不完、夾帶附件讓指令失靈，或是工作還沒跑完就提前結束。

載入長對話會等歷史重播完才回覆，不再滿 2 秒就截斷。接上執行中工作階段會保留權限與提問提示，找不到工作階段 ID 改回 `-32002` 錯誤碼，不再回 `-32603`。

先附加檔案、選取區、圖片或連結再打 `/plan`、`/compact` 等斜線指令或 skill，不會再被跳過。`0` 位元組空檔會保留，網址與帶行號資源連結不再被當成本機路徑。

主回覆寫完時若還有子代理或非 `daemon` 任務在跑，回合會跨過背景喚醒等它們完成並回報合計 `token` 用量。開發伺服器這類常駐任務仍立刻結束回合。

中斷或取消回合時，進行中的工具呼叫不再卡在編輯器裡。沒產出指令或差異的失敗工具呼叫，現在也會附上錯誤訊息。
body.en:
When connecting an editor to the agent through `agy acp`, conversations often failed to finish loading history, attachments broke commands, or turns ended before work was done.

Loading long conversations now waits for history replay to finish instead of cutting off after 2 seconds. Attaching to a running session preserves active permission and question prompts, and a missing session ID now returns error code `-32002` instead of `-32603`.

Leading slash commands or skills such as `/plan` or `/compact` are no longer skipped when files, selections, images, or links are attached ahead of them. Empty `0`-byte files are preserved, and web URLs or line-range resource links are no longer treated as local paths.

If subagents or non-`daemon` tasks are still running when the main reply finishes, the turn now stays open across background wake-ups until they finish and reports the combined `token` usage. Persistent tasks such as dev servers still end the turn right away.

When interrupting or canceling a turn, in-progress tool calls no longer stay stuck open in the editor. Failed tool calls that produced no command or diff output now include error messages as well.

items.original:
Fixed `agy acp` replying to `session/load` before finishing history replay (or cutting off replay after 2 seconds on long conversations), dropping active permission or question prompts when attaching to a running session, and returning JSON-RPC error `-32603` instead of `-32002` when a session ID does not exist.
Fixed `agy acp` skipping leading slash commands or skills (such as `/plan` or `/compact`) when the editor attached files, selections, images, or links ahead of the prompt text, dropping empty (`0`-byte) attached files, and treating web URLs or line-range resource links as local file paths.
Fixed `agy acp` ending a `session/prompt` turn as soon as the agent's initial reply finished while non-daemon background tasks or subagents were still running; the turn now stays open across background wake-ups until that work finishes and reports the combined token usage, while daemon tasks such as dev servers still let the turn end right away.
Fixed `agy acp` leaving in-progress tool calls stuck open in the editor when a turn is interrupted or canceled with `session/cancel`, and omitting error messages on failed tool calls that produced no command or diff output.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制分割終端機分頁不再重載跑掉
title.en: Remote Control split terminal tabs no longer reload

body.zh-TW: 在瀏覽器開著遠端操控介面、從側邊欄把指令視窗拆成兩格並排，以前畫面會突然整片刷新，害你原本滑到的位置跟游標焦點都不見，現在不會再發生了。現在新增分割窗格時，會保留最舊的那一格作為整組的主窗格與分頁標題。如果有終端機已經結束、同一時間又有另一個終端機開啟，畫面也會自動從已結束的分頁移開。
body.en: When splitting a terminal pane side by side from the side panel in the Remote Control browser view, the screen previously reloaded and lost your scroll position and focus, which no longer happens. Adding new split panes now keeps the oldest pane as the group's lead pane and tab title. When a terminal exits at the same time another terminal opens, the view also automatically moves off the exited tab.

items.original: Fixed splitting a terminal tab in the side panel of the Remote Control browser view reloading the terminal and losing its scroll position and focus, kept the oldest pane as the group's lead pane and tab title when new split panes are added, and moved off an exited terminal tab when another terminal opened at the same time.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制長對話載入舊訊息按鈕不再亂捲
title.en: Remote Control Long-Chat Load Older Messages Button No Longer Jumps

body.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁長對話頂端那顆可用鍵盤和螢幕閱讀器聚焦的 `Load older messages` 按鈕，以前常讓操作卡住。過去它在手機上會被標題列切到邊緣，聚焦或點擊後畫面還會捲回對話最底部。這些問題都已經修好，現在按 `Esc` 會收起這顆按鈕，不再誤關外層的手機抽屜。
body.en: The keyboard- and screen-reader-focusable `Load older messages` button at the top of long conversations in the Remote Control web view used to disrupt interaction. On mobile, it used to clip against the title bar, and focusing or clicking it would scroll the view back to the bottom of the conversation. These issues are now fixed, and pressing `Esc` dismisses the button instead of accidentally closing the outer mobile drawer.

items.original: Fixed the keyboard- and screen-reader-focusable `Load older messages` pill at the top of long conversations in the Remote Control browser view clipping against the mobile title bar, scrolling back to the bottom of the chat when focused or clicked, and letting `Esc` close an enclosing mobile drawer instead of dismissing the pill.

title.zh-TW: /thinking 即時展開思考過程
title.en: Stream /thinking live in real time

body.zh-TW: 好奇 AI 給出答案前是怎麼一步步推理出來的嗎？現在只要輸入 `/thinking on`，對話紀錄就會在模型思考的當下即時串流顯示完整思考過程，想關閉就輸入 `/thinking off`。思考結束後，這段內容也會維持展開，不用另外按 `Ctrl+O` 打開。相關設定會以 `"showThinking"` 記在 `settings.json` 裡，預設為關閉。⟦就像上數學課看老師在黑板推算，以前他只把最終答案寫出來，想看過程還得自己翻筆記；現在每一步推導都直接留在黑板上，隨時抬頭就看得到。⟧
body.en: Curious how the AI reasons step by step before giving an answer? Run `/thinking on` to stream the model's full thinking live in the transcript while it thinks, or `/thinking off` to turn it off. Finished thoughts stay expanded without pressing `Ctrl+O`. This setting is saved as `"showThinking"` in `settings.json` and is off by default. ⟦Picture a math class watching a teacher work on the blackboard: previously only the final answer was written up and you had to check your notes for the steps, but now every step stays right on the board whenever you look up.⟧

items.original: Added `/thinking` (`/thinking [on|off]`, saved as `"showThinking"` in `settings.json` and off by default) to stream the model's full thinking live in the transcript while it thinks and keep finished thoughts expanded without pressing `Ctrl+O`.

title.zh-TW: /swarm board 新增 Overview 總覽
title.en: Add Overview section to /swarm board

body.zh-TW:
同時派出一批代理分頭處理專案，只要終端機視窗至少有 28 列高，打開 `/swarm board` 就能看到即時更新的 `Overview` 區塊。這個區塊會列出整體目標與總進度，格式像 `Overview · N of M tasks done`，若有卡住的項目也會標出受阻數量。

下面還會顯示最多六條工作線，各自用狀態燈號標明每個背景工作單元目前是在執行、審核中、等待同伴、已失敗還是已完成。⟦跟看車站大廳的列車動態看板一樣，以前得一節一節車廂去問進度，現在抬頭就有總表，幾班準點、幾班誤點或卡在路上全在一眼之內。⟧
body.en:
When dispatching a group of agents to work on a project in parallel, opening `/swarm board` in a terminal at least 28 rows tall now shows a live `Overview` section. It displays the overall goal and task progress in the format `Overview · N of M tasks done`, along with any blocked count.

Below that, up to six workstream threads use status indicators to show whether each background worker is working, in review, waiting on a peer, failed, or done. ⟦A departure board in a train station concourse works the same way: instead of checking progress car by car, you can look up at one summary table to see how many trains are on time, delayed, or stuck on the tracks.⟧

items.original: Added a live `Overview` section to `/swarm board` on terminals at least 28 rows tall, showing the swarm's goal, overall task progress (`Overview · N of M tasks done` and any blocked count), and up to six workstream threads with status indicators for which workers are working, in review, waiting on a peer, failed, or done.

title.zh-TW: --remote-agent 新增 plan 模式
title.en: Add plan mode to --remote-agent

body.zh-TW:
派遠端代理動手改檔案或跑指令前，如果想先看過它的規劃，現在可以在 `--remote-agent` 工作階段使用新加入的 `plan` 模式。代理可以先調查並寫出計畫，供你在改檔或執行指令前審核。

按 `Shift+Tab` 可在目前工作階段切換模式而不改預設值；啟動時加 `--mode plan` 會直接進入規劃模式，接續舊對話也能用 `--mode` 覆寫原設定。

到 `/config` 的 `Remote Agent` 分頁調整 `Agent Mode`（`default`、`accept-edits`、`plan`），會立即套用到目前對話並存成新遠端工作階段的預設值。⟦找裁縫師傅改衣服時，你可以先請他用粉筆畫好修改記號，看看他打算怎麼改。⟧
body.en:
If you want to review a remote agent's plan before it edits files or runs commands, `--remote-agent` sessions now include `plan` mode. The agent can research and write a plan for your review before making changes or running commands.

Press `Shift+Tab` to switch modes for the current session without changing your saved default, start with `--mode plan` to enter plan mode right away, or pass `--mode` when resuming a conversation to override its saved setting.

Adjusting `Agent Mode` (`default`, `accept-edits`, `plan`) on the `Remote Agent` tab of `/config` updates the current conversation immediately and saves it as the default for new remote sessions. ⟦Think of taking clothes to a tailor: you can ask them to mark the alterations in chalk first so you can see how they plan to change the fit.⟧

items.original:
Added `plan` mode to `--remote-agent` sessions, so a remote agent can research and write a plan for your review before editing files or running commands: switch to it with `Shift+Tab`, start in it with `--mode plan`, or choose `plan` under `Agent Mode` on the `Remote Agent` tab of `/config`.
Added an `Agent Mode` setting (`default`, `accept-edits`, and `plan`) to the `Remote Agent` tab of `/config` in `--remote-agent` sessions: choosing a mode saves it as your default for new remote sessions and updates the current conversation, while `Shift+Tab` switches modes for the session without changing your saved default and `--mode` overrides a resumed conversation's saved mode.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 檔案分頁新增方向鈕
title.en: Add RTL direction button to Remote Control file tabs

body.zh-TW: 用 Remote Control 網頁版看筆記或純文字檔，若內容是由右向左書寫且段落開頭夾帶英文單字，過去整段常會莫名跳回靠左對齊。現在 `.md`、`.markdown` 與 `.txt` 分頁的標題列多了 `Switch to RTL text direction` 按鈕，點下去就能順暢顯示右向文字。裡面的程式碼區塊與行號仍會維持由左向右。⟦在由右往左寫的信紙上夾帶英文地址時，以前整行字會跟著英文被拉去左邊；現在按下切換鍵，信件正文穩穩靠右排好，只有地址與編號照舊從左讀。⟧
body.en: When viewing notes or plain text files in the Remote Control browser view, right-to-left prose starting with an English word used to snap unexpectedly to left alignment. Now the header of `.md`, `.markdown`, and `.txt` tabs includes a `Switch to RTL text direction` button so right-to-left text renders cleanly, while code blocks and line numbers stay left-to-right. ⟦Suppose you write a right-to-left letter that includes an English address: previously the whole line got pulled to the left with the English text, whereas pressing the toggle keeps the body aligned cleanly on the right while only the address and numbers read from the left.⟧

items.original: Added a `Switch to RTL text direction` button to the header of Markdown (`.md`, `.markdown`) and `.txt` file tabs in the side panel of the Remote Control browser view, so right-to-left prose renders cleanly without paragraphs that start with English words snapping left, while code blocks and line numbers stay left-to-right.

title.zh-TW: /model 可調 Orchestrator 雙模型
title.en: Configure both Orchestrator models in /model

body.zh-TW:
消費者方案在本地工作階段打開 `/model`，現在能在 `Orchestrator` 這一列同時指定 `Planner` 與 `Executor` 兩套模型，並各自調整思考 `Effort`。操作時用 `Tab` 或 `Shift+Tab` 在 `Planner`、`Executor` 與兩者的 `Effort` 滑桿之間移動，再用 `←` 與 `→` 調整目前選中的項目。

選好的組合會以 `"orchestrator"` 儲存在 `settings.json` 與 `--settings` 裡。終端機底下的 status line（顯示在底部的即時狀態列）也會在 `Orchestrator` 旁標出目前啟用的規劃模型。⟦雙人划船比賽要發揮戰力，以前只能照大會配好的組合硬划；現在你能自己挑誰當舵手看方向、誰當槳手出全力，連兩個人各自出幾分力都調得出來。⟧
body.en:
On consumer plans in local sessions, opening `/model` lets you pick both the `Planner` and `Executor` models on the `Orchestrator` row and adjust each one's thinking `Effort`. Press `Tab` or `Shift+Tab` to move between `Planner`, `Executor`, and their `Effort` sliders, then use `←` and `→` to change the selected choice.

Your selection is saved under `"orchestrator"` in `settings.json` and `--settings`. The status line (the live bar at the bottom of the terminal) also shows the active planner model next to `Orchestrator`. ⟦To get the most out of a two-person rowing race, you previously had to row with whatever pairing the organizers assigned; now you can pick who steers the course and who pulls the oars, and even tune how much power each one puts in.⟧

items.original: Improved the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` on consumer plans in local sessions so you can pick both its `Planner` and `Executor` models and each one's thinking `Effort` (saved under `"orchestrator"` in `settings.json` and `--settings`): press `Tab` or `Shift+Tab` to move between `Planner`, `Executor`, and their `Effort` sliders, use `←` and `→` to change the focused choice, and see the active planner next to `Orchestrator` in the status line.

title.zh-TW: medium 模式展開工具群組保留色彩與縮排
title.en: Keep colors and indentation in expanded medium tool groups

body.zh-TW: 在 `medium` 詳細程度下按 `Ctrl+O` 或點擊檢視折疊項目，以前摘要標題會整條變灰，連失敗的紅色狀態標記也不例外。現在摘要標題列會保留原本的色彩，展開後的工具呼叫則會往內縮排，放在一條 `│` 邊線之後。
body.en: When expanding collapsed items in `medium` verbosity with `Ctrl+O` or by clicking, the summary header previously dimmed to gray—even red status markers on failed runs. Now the summary header row keeps its original colors, and expanded tool calls are indented behind a `│` gutter.

items.original: Improved expanded tool groups in `medium` verbosity: expanding a group with `Ctrl+O` or by clicking now keeps the summary header's colors, including red status markers on failed runs, instead of dimming it to gray, and indents the expanded tool calls behind a `│` gutter.

title.zh-TW: 網頁版工作區外授權改建議專案資料夾
title.en: Suggest project folders for outside-workspace prompts on web

body.zh-TW:
用 Remote Control 網頁版請代理在工作區外新增或編輯檔案，權限提示現在會提供更寬的「永遠允許」建議。它會優先建議授權所屬儲存庫或專案資料夾，若沒有所屬專案則建議上一層資料夾，不必每次只放行單一檔案。

不過，像 `.env` 或 SSH 金鑰這類敏感檔案，以及家目錄或 `/tmp` 這類大範圍資料夾，選項仍會限制在該單一檔案。如果在提示框裡手動修改目標路徑，也會蓋掉原本的建議範圍。⟦向學校借教室辦活動時，以前每拿一隻麥克風都要單獨寫一張借條，現在會建議你一次借整個社團器材室，唯有保險箱裡的貴重器材還是要逐件簽領。⟧
body.en:
When asking an agent to create or edit a file outside the workspace in the Remote Control browser view, permission prompts now offer a broader "always allow" suggestion. They suggest the enclosing repository or project folder first, or the parent folder when there is none, instead of approving only one file at a time.

However, sensitive files such as `.env` or SSH keys and broad folders such as your home directory or `/tmp` remain limited to that single file. Editing the target path in the prompt also overrides the suggested scope. ⟦When borrowing a room at school for an event, you previously had to sign a separate slip for every microphone; now you are offered the whole club equipment room at once, except for valuables in the safe that still require individual sign-off.⟧

items.original: Improved permission prompts for creating or editing a file outside the workspace in the Remote Control browser view: the "always allow" options now suggest the enclosing repository or project folder (or the parent folder when there is none) instead of only that single file, while sensitive files such as `.env` or SSH keys and broad folders such as your home directory or `/tmp` stay limited to the exact file, and editing the target path in the prompt overrides the suggestion.

title.zh-TW: 網頁版連續啟動子代理改為收合顯示
title.en: Collapse consecutive subagent launches in browser view

body.zh-TW: 打開 Remote Control 瀏覽器畫面看對話，如果單一回合接連派出好幾個子代理，相鄰的啟動紀錄現在不再逐條攤開。相鄰的啟動項目會縮成單一列 `Started N subagents`，啟動進行中則顯示 `Starting N subagents`，點開就能查看並開啟每個子代理。
body.en: When viewing a conversation in the Remote Control browser view, consecutive subagent launches within a single turn are no longer listed one by one. Adjacent launches collapse into a single `Started N subagents` row—or `Starting N subagents` while launching—that you can expand to view and open each subagent.

items.original: Improved turns that launch several subagents in a row in the Remote Control browser view: consecutive subagent launches now collapse into a single `Started N subagents` row (`Starting N subagents` while launching) that you can expand to see and open each subagent.

title.zh-TW: Auto 模式放寬免詢問直接讀取工作區外檔案
title.en: Allow Auto mode to read outside workspace without asking

body.zh-TW:
用預設的 `Agent Mode`（Auto 模式）跑任務，過去只要需要查看目前專案資料夾以外的檔案，都會先跳出確認視窗，除非你特地到 `/config` 開啟 `Non-Workspace Access`。現在 Auto 模式改為可以直接讀取工作區外的檔案，不再另外請示。

不過限制並沒有全部放開，在工作區外寫入或修改檔案仍須經你同意。你設定的 `ask` 與 `deny` 權限規則、像 `mcp_config.json` 這類受保護的設定檔、其他專案的對話紀錄，以及組織要求審查工作區外檔案的政策都照樣有效。⟦去鄰居書房借參考資料時，以前連翻開書看兩眼都要先問過主人，現在只要是純看書就能直接翻閱，但想拿筆改裡面的字，還是得先開口取得同意。⟧
body.en:
When running tasks in the default `Agent Mode` (Auto mode), viewing files outside the current project folder previously triggered a confirmation prompt unless you enabled `Non-Workspace Access` in `/config`. Auto mode now reads files outside the workspace directly without asking.

Not all restrictions are lifted, though—writing or editing files outside the workspace still requires your approval. Your `ask` and `deny` permission rules, protected config files such as `mcp_config.json`, other projects' conversations, and organization policies requiring outside-workspace file review all still apply. ⟦Consider borrowing reference books from a neighbor's study: previously you had to ask the owner just to open a book and glance at it, whereas now you can read freely, though picking up a pen to edit the text still requires asking first.⟧

items.original: Changed Auto mode (the default `Agent Mode`) to allow reading files outside the workspace without asking for approval; previously Auto mode prompted before reading outside the workspace unless `Non-Workspace Access` was turned on in `/config`. Writing or editing files outside the workspace still asks for approval, and your `ask` and `deny` permission rules, protected configuration files such as `mcp_config.json`, other projects' conversations, and organization policies requiring outside-workspace file review still apply.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 特殊路徑外洩憑證漏洞
title.en: Fix Windows credential leak via special paths

body.zh-TW: Windows 版先前在工作區權限規則、`@` 檔案提及、外掛、`sidecars.json` 與自訂代理中，遇到 UNC 網路、裝置或 NT 物件路徑時會有安全風險。這類路徑可能觸發查詢並把 Windows 登入憑證送到遠端主機，現在會直接拒絕而不存取。
body.en: On Windows, UNC network, device, and NT object paths in workspace permission rules, `@` file mentions, plugins, `sidecars.json`, and custom agents previously posed a security risk. Those paths could trigger a lookup that sent Windows login credentials to a remote host, and are now rejected without being accessed.

items.original: Fixed a security issue on Windows where network (UNC), device, and NT object paths in workspace permission rules, `@` file mentions, plugins, `sidecars.json`, and custom agents could trigger a lookup that sent Windows credentials to a remote host; those paths are now rejected without being accessed.

title.zh-TW: 修正中斷回覆誤跑工具並導致驗證失敗
title.en: Fix interrupted responses running partial tools and failing validation

body.zh-TW: 模型回覆如果中途出錯、被取消或被截斷，過去不完整的內容裡若帶有半套工具呼叫仍可能被執行。重試時也可能把那次壞掉的嘗試再送出去，導致後續對話出現思考簽章驗證錯誤，現在這些問題都已經修好。
body.en: When a model response errored out, was canceled, or got cut off partway through, partial tool calls in the incomplete response could still run. Retrying could also resend that broken attempt, causing thinking-signature validation errors in later turns; both issues are now fixed.

items.original: Fixed model responses that error out, are canceled, or are cut off partway through running partial tool calls from the incomplete response or resending that broken attempt on retry, which could make later turns fail with thinking-signature validation errors.

title.zh-TW: 修正窄終端機寬表格標題截斷與斷字問題
title.en: Fix wide table headers and mid-word breaks on narrow terminals

body.zh-TW: 在較窄的終端機觀看代理回覆的寬版 Markdown 表格，以前欄位標題會被截成 `…`，文字欄也擠到把單字從中間拆斷。這個排版問題已經修好，現在標題會正常換行，欄寬調整後能保住完整單字，只折斷長路徑與網址。
body.en: When viewing wide Markdown tables from agent responses on narrow terminals, column headers used to get cut off with `…` and text columns were squeezed until words broke mid-word. This layout issue is fixed: headers now wrap properly, and column widths keep whole words intact while only breaking long paths and URLs.

items.original: Fixed wide Markdown tables in agent responses cutting off column headers with `…` and squeezing text columns until words broke mid-word on narrow terminals; headers now wrap and columns are sized to keep words intact while breaking long paths and URLs.

title.zh-TW: 修正外掛 $schema 清單解析與名稱截斷
title.en: Fix plugin $schema listing errors and name truncation

body.zh-TW:
外掛的 `plugin.json` 若宣告了 Agent Plugins `$schema`，過去用 `/plugin`、`agy plugin list`、`agy plugin enable` 與 `agy plugin install` 查看或操作時會列錯項目。技能、子代理、MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器與掛鉤清單都會出錯，例如錯讀 `mcp_config.json` 而非 `mcp.json`。

把 `hooks.json` 誤報成名為 `$schema` 與 `hooks` 的 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）這項錯誤已經修好。`agy plugin install` 摘要在 `.` 處截斷子代理名稱的問題也一併解決。
body.en:
When a plugin's `plugin.json` declared an Agent Plugins `$schema`, `/plugin`, `agy plugin list`, `agy plugin enable`, and `agy plugin install` used to list the wrong items. Skills, subagents, MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers, and hooks were all listed incorrectly, such as reading `mcp_config.json` instead of `mcp.json`.

The bug that misreported `hooks.json` as hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) named `$schema` and `hooks` is now fixed. The `agy plugin install` summary cutting off subagent names at `.` is also resolved.

items.original: Fixed `/plugin`, `agy plugin list`, `agy plugin enable`, and `agy plugin install` listing the wrong skills, subagents, MCP servers, and hooks for plugins whose `plugin.json` declares an Agent Plugins `$schema` (such as reading `mcp_config.json` instead of `mcp.json` or reporting `hooks.json` as hooks named `$schema` and `hooks`), and fixed the `agy plugin install` summary cutting off subagent names at a `.`.

title.zh-TW: 修正外掛市集安裝失敗與錯誤登入提示
title.en: Fix marketplace plugin install failures and sign-in prompts

body.zh-TW:
改用 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 連線而不靠已儲存的登入帳號，過去執行 `agy plugin install <plugin>@<marketplace>` 會跳出 `unknown marketplace` 錯誤。這個安裝失敗的問題已經修好。

代理在回覆中推薦外掛時，即使該外掛還沒安裝，以前也會附上原始市集編號顯示 `The <id> plugin needs you to sign in. Open /plugin to sign in.`。現在這句提示改為 `Open /plugin to install or sign in to this plugin.`。
body.en:
When connecting with `GEMINI_API_KEY` instead of a saved sign-in, running `agy plugin install <plugin>@<marketplace>` used to fail with an `unknown marketplace` error. This installation failure is now fixed.

When an agent suggested a plugin in its response, it used to include a raw marketplace ID and say `The <id> plugin needs you to sign in. Open /plugin to sign in.` even if the plugin was not installed. That prompt now reads `Open /plugin to install or sign in to this plugin.`.

items.original:
Fixed `agy plugin install <plugin>@<marketplace>` failing with `unknown marketplace` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY` instead of a saved sign-in.
Fixed plugin suggestions in agent responses telling you `The <id> plugin needs you to sign in. Open /plugin to sign in.` with a raw marketplace catalog ID even when the plugin was not installed; they now say `Open /plugin to install or sign in to this plugin.`

title.zh-TW: 修正點數歸零卻一直亮出紅色餘額警告
title.en: Fix persistent red out-of-credits warning at zero balance

body.zh-TW: 啟用 AI 點數且點數餘額為 `0` 時，就算你還有一般模型額度可用，狀態列過去仍會一直掛著紅色的 `AI: Out of credits` 警告。這個問題已經修好，現在狀態列只有在點數餘額大於 `0` 時才會顯示 AI 點數。
body.en: When AI credits were enabled and your credit balance was `0`, the status line used to keep showing a red `AI: Out of credits` warning even while normal model quota was still available. This is now fixed, and the status line only shows AI credits when your balance is greater than `0`.

items.original: Fixed the status line permanently showing a red `AI: Out of credits` warning when AI credits are enabled and your credit balance is `0`, even while normal model quota is still available; the status line now shows AI credits only when you have a positive balance.

title.zh-TW: 修正遠端代理列出不支援的本機模型
title.en: Fix remote agents listing unsupported local models

body.zh-TW:
在 `--remote-agent` 工作階段下 `/model` 挑選項時，過去清單裡仍看得到實際跑不動的項目，選了也只會跳出一段令人一頭霧水的錯誤。現在 `/model` 會把遠端代理不支援的模型標上 `not available for remote agents`，並省略本機自訂模型。

若改用不支援的模型送出請求，則會明確回報這則錯誤訊息：

```text
<model> isn't available for remote conversations yet. Choose another model and try again.
```
body.en:
When choosing a model with `/model` in a `--remote-agent` session, the list used to include options that could not actually run, and picking one threw a confusing error. Now `/model` labels models unsupported by remote agents as `not available for remote agents` and omits local custom models.

If you send a request with an unsupported model, it now clearly reports this error message:

```text
<model> isn't available for remote conversations yet. Choose another model and try again.
```

items.original: Fixed `--remote-agent` sessions offering local-only and custom models that remote agents cannot run, and showing an unexplained error when a model is unavailable remotely: `/model` now marks models that remote agents don't support as `not available for remote agents` and omits local custom models, and requests with an unsupported model report `<model> isn't available for remote conversations yet. Choose another model and try again.`

title.zh-TW: 修正按 Esc 取消送出與續發訊息異常
title.en: Fix Esc failing to cancel sends and breaking follow-up messages

body.zh-TW:
送出訊息後、畫面上明明已經顯示 `esc to cancel` 正在做送前檢查，這時按下 `Esc` 過去卻攔不住訊息送出，反而照樣跑完一整輪代理回應。現在在這個空檔按 `Esc` 會直接中止發送，並顯示 `Message not sent: canceled before it was sent`。

上一輪還在收尾清理時若按 `Esc` 取消，過去會清掉 `Interrupted` 狀態提示。緊接著送出的下一則訊息，還會被以 `executor has not processed the previous input yet` 擋下。現在 `Interrupted` 提示會繼續留著，後續訊息也會排隊等到取消完成再處理。
body.en:
Right after submitting a message, while `esc to cancel` was already shown during pre-send checks, pressing `Esc` used to fail to stop the send and still ran a full agent turn. Pressing `Esc` in that window now aborts the send and displays `Message not sent: canceled before it was sent`.

Pressing `Esc` to cancel while the previous turn was still tearing down used to clear the `Interrupted` status hint, and an immediate follow-up message would be rejected with `executor has not processed the previous input yet`. The `Interrupted` hint now stays visible, and follow-up messages queue until cancellation finishes.

items.original:
Fixed pressing `Esc` right after submitting a message — while the CLI already showed `esc to cancel` during pre-send checks — failing to stop the message from being sent and running a full agent turn; canceling in that window now aborts the send and shows `Message not sent: canceled before it was sent`.
Fixed pressing `Esc` to cancel a turn while it is still tearing down clearing the `Interrupted` status hint and rejecting an immediate follow-up message with `executor has not processed the previous input yet`; the `Interrupted` hint now stays visible and follow-up messages queue until cancellation finishes.

title.zh-TW: 修正逾時取消的命令掛鉤殘留背景行程
title.en: Fix timed-out or canceled command hooks leaving background processes

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 與 macOS 透過 `hooks.json` 觸發外部指令時，過去執行到一半被中斷或等太久停掉後，它衍生的子任務仍會留在背後繼續跑。這個問題已經修好，現在停止命令型掛鉤時會一併結束它的整個行程群組。
body.en: When external commands were triggered via `hooks.json` on Linux and macOS, child processes used to keep running in the background if the hook was canceled mid-run or timed out. This is now fixed, and stopping a command hook terminates its entire process group.

items.original: Fixed command hooks in `hooks.json` on Linux and macOS leaving child processes running in the background after a hook times out or is canceled; stopping a hook now terminates its entire process group.

title.zh-TW: 修正工作流腳本末尾寫 return 會報錯
title.en: Fix workflow scripts failing on trailing return statements

body.zh-TW: `run_workflow` 執行結尾帶有頂層 `return` 的 Python 工作流腳本，過去會跳出 `workflow syntax error: 'return' outside function` 而失敗。現在腳本末尾的 `return` 會直接被評估為這個工作流的執行結果。
body.en: When `run_workflow` ran a Python workflow script ending with a top-level `return`, it used to fail with `workflow syntax error: 'return' outside function`. Now a trailing `return` is evaluated directly as the workflow's result.

items.original: Fixed `run_workflow` failing with `workflow syntax error: 'return' outside function` when a Python workflow script ends with a top-level `return` statement; a trailing `return` is now evaluated as the workflow's result.

title.zh-TW: 修正網頁版停止或插隊送出時弄丟草稿
title.en: Fix browser Stop and Send Now losing message drafts

body.zh-TW:
在 Remote Control 網頁版剛送出追問訊息、還沒傳送完成就立刻按下 `Stop`，過去整則訊息會直接消失。現在它會連同 `@` 提及、附件與審查留言一起退回輸入框，接在你後來新打的文字後面。

對排隊中的訊息點 `Send Now` 時，以前輸入框裡打到一半的草稿、附件或審查留言會被清空覆寫。現在這些內容都會保留下來，連續點擊多次 `Send Now` 也會依序送出。
body.en:
In the Remote Control browser view, pressing `Stop` right after submitting a follow-up message before it finished sending used to drop the entire message. It is now returned to the message box along with its `@` mentions, attachments, and review comments, placed after any new text you started typing.

Clicking `Send Now` on a queued message used to clear or overwrite any in-progress draft, attachments, or review comments in the message box. All of those are now preserved, and multiple `Send Now` clicks are sent in order.

items.original:
Fixed pressing `Stop` right after submitting a follow-up message in the Remote Control browser view, before the message finished sending, dropping your message; it is now put back in the message box with its `@` mentions, attachments, and review comments, after anything new you've started typing.
Fixed clicking `Send Now` on a queued message in the Remote Control browser view clearing or overwriting a draft, attachments, or review comments you were typing in the message box, and kept multiple `Send Now` clicks in order.

title.zh-TW: 修正非 Markdown 產出物留言計數異常
title.en: Fix Comment Count Bugs on Non-Markdown Artifacts

body.zh-TW: 在 Remote Control 網頁版側邊欄對程式碼或其他非 Markdown 產出物加上行內留言，過去顯示與送出都會出錯。`Review` 按鈕上的留言數會停在零，側邊欄與 `Overview Panel` 也漏掉計數徽章，按下 `Proceed` 還會拆成多個獨立膠囊。現在這些問題都已經修好。
body.en: Adding inline comments to code or other non-Markdown artifacts in the side panel of the Remote Control browser view previously caused display and submission errors. The comment count on the `Review` button stayed at zero, the sidebar and `Overview Panel` were also missing comment-count badges, and clicking `Proceed` split them into separate pills. These issues are now fixed.

items.original: Fixed inline comments added to code and other non-Markdown artifacts in the side panel of the Remote Control browser view leaving the `Review` button at zero comments, missing comment-count badges in the sidebar and Overview Panel, and splitting into separate pills when you click `Proceed`.

title.zh-TW: 修正 iPhone 網頁版輸入框與鍵盤錯位
title.en: Fix iPhone Browser Message Box Alignment

body.zh-TW: 拿 iPhone 打開 Remote Control 瀏覽器介面傳訊息時，打字區過去不是滑到螢幕下方被蓋住，就是浮在半空中留出一塊空白。不論是對話頁、首頁，還是子代理分頁這類側邊欄抽屜裡，這個與螢幕鍵盤對不齊的問題現在都已經修好。
body.en: When sending messages in the Remote Control browser view on an iPhone, the message box previously either slid behind the on-screen keyboard or floated in mid-air with a blank gap. This misalignment with the on-screen keyboard is now fixed in conversations, on the home screen, and in side-panel drawers such as subagent tabs.

items.original: Fixed the message box in the Remote Control browser view on iPhone either sliding behind the on-screen keyboard or floating with a blank gap above it in conversations, on the home screen, and in side-panel drawers such as subagent tabs.

title.zh-TW: 模型清單新增 Gemini 4 Neon
title.en: Gemini 4 Neon added to model list

body.zh-TW: 想改用新模型處理手邊的開發或資料整理工作，現在只要透過 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 應用程式預設憑證登入，就能在指令裡選到它。在對話輸入 `/model`，或於啟動時帶上 `--model`，裡面多了 Gemini 4 Neon 的 `Low`、`Medium`、`High` 與 `XHigh` 四個選項。公司有架設企業模型閘道（集中控管連線的模型入口）的話，透過閘道也已支援 Gemini 4 Neon。⟦就像工具箱裡新添了一把四段力道的電鑽，不論用個人識別證或走公司統一入口，都能直接拿來上工。⟧
body.en: If you want to switch to a new model for your development or data-wrangling work, you can now select it in commands as long as you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`). Enter `/model` in a conversation or pass `--model` at startup to see four new options for Gemini 4 Neon: `Low`, `Medium`, `High`, and `XHigh`. If your company runs an enterprise model gateway (a central entry point that controls model connections), Gemini 4 Neon is supported through it as well. ⟦Picture adding a four-speed power drill to your toolbox: whether you badge in with your own ID or walk through the company gate, you can pick it up and get right to work.⟧

items.original: Added Gemini 4 Neon (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) to `/model` and `--model` when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), and added support for Gemini 4 Neon through an enterprise model gateway.

title.zh-TW: Markdown 表格拖曳複製只取選定欄位
title.en: Markdown table drag-copy selects only chosen columns

body.zh-TW:
從 AI 生成的表格複製一欄文字，以前常把框線跟旁邊那欄的字一併帶進剪貼簿。這個改動套用在 `full screen (altscreen)` 顯示模式，以及用來瀏覽生成結果的產物檢視器。

只要滑鼠從 Markdown 表格內開始拖曳，選取範圍就會沿著欄位走。只在單一欄內拖曳，就只會複製那一欄的文字；跨欄拖曳時，則會複製完整儲存格並以 Tab 字元隔開，不再帶入框線或隔壁欄的字。⟦抄寫藥盒背面那張成分表時，以前手指一滑就會連格線和隔壁欄一起念錯行，現在視線會穩穩鎖在你要的那幾欄上。⟧
body.en:
Copying a column of text from an AI-generated table used to pull borders and words from the neighboring column into your clipboard. This change applies to the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode and the artifact viewer used to browse generated results.

Whenever a mouse drag starts inside a Markdown table, the selection now follows its columns. Dragging within a single column copies only the text in that column; dragging across columns copies whole cells separated by tabs, without bringing in borders or text from adjacent columns. ⟦Think of reading an ingredients chart on the back of a medicine box: a slip of your finger used to drag your eyes across grid lines into the wrong column, whereas now your gaze stays locked onto the columns you want.⟧

items.original: Improved mouse selection in Markdown tables in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode and the artifact viewer: a drag that starts in a table now follows its columns, so you copy only the text of the column you drag in, or whole cells separated by tabs when you drag across columns, instead of the borders and the text of neighboring columns.

title.zh-TW: 代理合併執行多步驟任務以減少輪數
title.en: Agent batches multi-step tasks to take fewer turns

body.zh-TW: 交辦一個包含搜尋、讀寫檔案和下指令的任務，過去代理常拆成多輪分次處理。現在遇到這類多步驟任務，它會把彼此獨立的搜尋、讀檔與編輯集中到同一步驟一起執行，並將相關的終端機指令串成單一指令，因此能用更少的輪數完成任務。⟦跟進廚房備料一樣，以前洗一根蔥走一趟流理台、拿瓶醬油又走一趟，現在把互不衝突的備菜一次做好，相連的動作順手串起來，出餐就少繞好多彎。⟧
body.en: When given a task involving searches, file reads and writes, and shell commands, the agent used to split the work across multiple turns. Now, on multi-step tasks like these, it runs independent searches, file reads, and edits together in a single step and chains related shell commands into one command, completing the task in fewer turns. ⟦A cook prepping ingredients in a kitchen used to walk to the sink to wash one scallion and make another trip just for soy sauce; now all non-conflicting prep happens at once and connected steps are chained together, cutting out wasted trips before plating.⟧

items.original: Improved how the agent works through multi-step tasks: it now runs independent searches, file reads, and edits together in one step and chains related shell commands into a single command, so tasks take fewer turns.

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型不再忽略 settings.json 停用旗標
title.en: Custom models no longer ignore disabled flags in settings.json

body.zh-TW: 接上自己設定的模型卻老是收到思考或工具呼叫請求，以前就算把功能關掉也照送不誤。這個問題已經修好，現在只要在 `settings.json` 的 `modelFeatures` 把 `supportsThinking` 或 `supportsToolCalls` 設為 `false`，CLI 就不會再向不支援的模型要求這些功能。
body.en: Connecting a custom model used to still trigger thinking or tool-call requests even when those features were turned off. This issue is fixed: setting `supportsThinking` or `supportsToolCalls` to `false` under `modelFeatures` in `settings.json` now stops the CLI from requesting those features from models that do not support them.

items.original: Fixed custom models in `settings.json` ignoring `modelFeatures` flags set to `false`, such as `supportsThinking` and `supportsToolCalls`, so the CLI no longer requests thinking or tool calls from a model you've marked as not supporting them.

title.zh-TW: 代理不再擅自開啟 swarm 消耗額度
title.en: Agents no longer start swarm on their own and burn quota

body.zh-TW: 沒輸入 `/swarm` 的情況下，以前代理有時會擅自啟動 swarm（多代理協作模式），消耗比單一代理多出許多的額度。這個問題已經修好，目前不會再將 swarm 技能提供給代理主動呼叫，而你手動輸入 `/swarm` 依然跟以前一樣能正常使用。
body.en: Even without typing `/swarm`, agents used to occasionally launch swarm (multi-agent collaboration mode) on their own and use far more quota than a single agent. This issue is fixed: the swarm skill is no longer offered to the agent to invoke proactively, while typing `/swarm` manually still works as before.

items.original: Fixed agents starting a swarm on their own when you hadn't typed `/swarm`, which can use far more of your quota than a single agent; the swarm skill is no longer offered to the agent, and `/swarm` works as before.

title.zh-TW: 非 QWERTY 鍵盤快捷鍵改依配置對應
title.en: Shortcuts on non-QWERTY keyboards now follow your layout

body.zh-TW: 習慣用非標準 QWERTY 鍵盤在 Ghostty 等終端機打字，以前按 `Ctrl` 或 `Alt` 快捷鍵常會誤觸別的鍵。這個問題已經修好，無論 Neo2、Dvorak、AZERTY 或德文 QWERTZ 配置，`Ctrl+C`、`Ctrl+D` 等組合鍵現在都會依實際鍵盤配置運作。
body.en: If you type on a non-QWERTY keyboard in terminals like Ghostty, pressing `Ctrl` or `Alt` shortcuts used to register as a different key. This issue is fixed: across Neo2, Dvorak, AZERTY, and German QWERTZ layouts, shortcuts like `Ctrl+C` and `Ctrl+D` now follow your active keyboard layout.

items.original: Fixed `Ctrl` and `Alt` shortcuts, such as `Ctrl+C` and `Ctrl+D`, acting as a different key on non-QWERTY keyboard layouts like Neo2, Dvorak, AZERTY, or German QWERTZ in terminals such as Ghostty; shortcuts now follow your keyboard layout.

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式在驚嘆號模式執行命令不再只換行
title.en: Enter in Vim `!` shell mode now runs commands instead of adding a newline

body.zh-TW: 開著 Vim 操作、打 `!` 進終端機下指令，過去打完按 `Enter` 卻只會往下多空一行，指令送不出去。這個問題已經修好，現在於相同模式下按 `Enter` 就會直接執行指令。
body.en: When Vim mode was on and you typed `!` to enter shell mode and run a command, pressing `Enter` used to just insert a blank line instead of submitting it. This issue is fixed: pressing `Enter` in that mode now runs the command directly.

items.original: Fixed `Enter` adding a new line instead of running the command in `!` shell mode when Vim mode is on.

title.zh-TW: Termux 執行 agy update 不再失敗
title.en: agy update no longer fails in Termux

body.zh-TW: 跑 `agy update` 更新工具，Android 的 Termux 環境過去總是失敗。畫面上會跳出 `directory /apex/com.android.runtime/bin is not fully accessible` 錯誤。這個問題已經修好，現在在 Termux 執行這項指令不會再出現這個錯誤。
body.en: Running `agy update` to update the tool used to fail in Android's Termux environment with a `directory /apex/com.android.runtime/bin is not fully accessible` error. This issue is fixed, and running the command in Termux no longer triggers that error.

items.original: Fixed `agy update` on Android (Termux) failing with a `directory /apex/com.android.runtime/bin is not fully accessible` error.

title.zh-TW: /config 的 Send Immediately 提示更正
title.en: Corrected Send Immediately hint in /config

body.zh-TW: 代理還在跑的時候想先插話傳訊息，以前看設定畫面的說明會以為送出就會直接打斷目前工作。這項說明現在已經更正，在 `/config` 的 `Queued Messages` 底下查看 `Send Immediately` 選項，會清楚寫明你的訊息會加入目前這輪對話，代理跑完眼前的這一步後就會讀到。
body.en: When you wanted to send a message while the agent was still running, the hint on the settings screen used to make it sound like sending would interrupt the current work right away. That hint is now corrected: under `Queued Messages` in `/config`, the `Send Immediately` option clearly states that your message joins the current turn and the agent reads it after finishing its current step.

items.original: Fixed the `/config` hint for the `Send Immediately` option of `Queued Messages`, which said it interrupts the agent; it now says your message joins the current turn and the agent reads it after its current step.

title.zh-TW: JSON 輸出重試成功後改回報 SUCCESS
title.en: JSON output now reports SUCCESS after a retried request succeeds

body.zh-TW: 用 `--output-format json` 或 `stream-json` 讀取結果，過去只要中途重試過模型請求，就算最後成功，`status` 仍會顯示 `ERROR` 並夾帶舊錯誤。這個問題已經修好，現在只要 CLI 重試後完成執行，結果的 `status` 就會正確寫成 `SUCCESS`。
body.en: When reading output with `--output-format json` or `stream-json`, any run that had retried a model request along the way used to still report `status` as `ERROR` along with the stale error, even if it ultimately succeeded. This issue is fixed: once the CLI completes a run after a retry, the result's `status` is now accurately reported as `SUCCESS`.

items.original: Fixed the `status` of `--output-format json` and `stream-json` results reading `ERROR`, with the error of a failed attempt, for runs that succeeded after the CLI retried a model request; they now report `SUCCESS`.

title.zh-TW: 外部編輯器連 agy acp 的操作與顯示修正
title.en: Operation and display fixes for external editors connected via agy acp

body.zh-TW:
透過 `agy acp` 把 Zed 或 JetBrains AI Chat 這類編輯器連上 Antigravity，現在檔案路徑、選單與訊息呈現都照實運作。

代理執行終端機指令的目錄以前會誤用編輯器啟動時的位置，例如家目錄；現在改回在該工作階段的專案資料夾執行。

在 Zed 等編輯器附上還沒存檔的內容給代理時，以前代理只看得到硬碟上舊的存檔；現在能直接讀取編輯器傳來的最新內容。

接上企業模型閘道時，編輯器模型選單過去會出現內部 `MODEL_PLACEHOLDER_...` 代號與重複名稱；現在每個模型只依代號列一次，同名模型旁也會標出代號。

模型請求重試時，編輯器聊天室以前每次都會跳出 `API error (attempt N)`，連後來成功也不例外。現在重試過程比照終端機保持安靜，只有全部重試都失敗時才顯示錯誤。
body.en:
When you connect editors like Zed or JetBrains AI Chat to Antigravity via `agy acp`, file paths, menus, and messages now work as expected.

Previously, the agent ran terminal commands in the directory the editor launched from, such as your home directory; it now runs them in the session's project folder instead.

When attaching unsaved content to the agent in editors like Zed, the agent previously only saw the older saved version on disk; it can now read the latest content sent by the editor directly.

When connected to an enterprise model gateway, the editor's model picker previously showed internal `MODEL_PLACEHOLDER_...` IDs and duplicate names; each model is now listed once by its ID, and models sharing a name show their ID next to it.

When a model request was retried, the editor's chat previously displayed `API error (attempt N)` every time, even if the retry later succeeded. Retries are now silent, just like in the terminal, and an error is shown only when all retries fail.

items.original:
Fixed `agy acp` running the agent's shell commands in the directory the editor launched it from, such as your home directory, instead of the session's project folder.
Fixed `agy acp` ignoring the file contents an editor attaches to a prompt, such as a file with unsaved changes in Zed; the agent now sees the editor's copy instead of the last saved version on disk.
Fixed model pickers in editors connected through `agy acp`, such as Zed and JetBrains AI Chat, showing internal `MODEL_PLACEHOLDER_...` IDs and several rows with the same name when you use an enterprise model gateway; each model is now listed once under its model ID, and models that share a name show their ID next to it.
Fixed `agy acp` showing an `API error (attempt N)` message in the editor's chat each time the CLI retried a model request, even when the retry succeeded; retries are now silent, as in the terminal, and the chat shows an error only when every retry fails.

title.zh-TW: /antigravity-guide 不再讀成轉址頁
title.en: /antigravity-guide no longer reads a redirect page

body.zh-TW: 問代理最新版本有什麼新東西，讓它透過內建 `/antigravity-guide` 技能查官方文件或更新紀錄時，過去只會讀到轉址通知，讀不到實際頁面。這個問題已經修好，現在能讀到頁面內容來回答問題。
body.en: When you asked the agent what's new in the latest release and it used the built-in `/antigravity-guide` skill to check the official docs or changelog, it previously read only a redirect notice instead of the actual page. This has been fixed, and it can now read the page content to answer your questions.

items.original: Fixed the built-in `/antigravity-guide` skill reading a redirect notice instead of the page when the agent looked up the Antigravity docs or changelog to answer your questions, such as what's new in the latest release.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁回答權限提示不再跳位或重置
title.en: Remote Control web view no longer jumps or resets when answering permission prompts

body.zh-TW:
在遠端控制網頁替代理批核請求，以前送出回答後畫面常會跑掉，網路微斷一下還得重填。

回答完權限提示後，過去對話畫面會隨著提示框關閉往下滑動，打亂原本的閱讀位置；現在對話會停在你正在看的段落。

若遇到短暫斷線，權限提示原本會整個重置，導致你挑好的選項、修改過的指令或路徑，以及在 `No` 欄位輸入的文字全部遺失；現在這些內容都會保留下來。
body.en:
When approving requests for the agent in the Remote Control web view, the view previously often jumped after you submitted an answer, and a brief network drop forced you to fill it out again.

After answering a permission prompt, the conversation view previously slid down as the prompt closed, disrupting your reading position; the conversation now stays on the section you are reading.

If a brief disconnection occurred, the permission prompt previously reset completely, losing the option you picked, your edits to the command or path, and any text typed into the `No` field; all of these are now preserved.

items.original:
Fixed the Remote Control browser view jumping when you answer a permission prompt; the conversation now stays where you were reading instead of sliding down as the prompt closes.
Fixed permission prompts in the Remote Control browser view resetting after a brief connection drop, which lost the option you had picked, your edits to the command or path, and anything you had typed for the `No` option.

title.zh-TW: 儀表板新增 /rename 幫工作階段改名
title.en: Dashboard adds /rename to rename sessions

body.zh-TW: 列表中同時留著好幾條舊紀錄，想替其中一條換個好認的標記，卻不想一一打開。現在選好目標後輸入 `/rename`，就能直接把那個工作階段改名，不用先打開它。⟦就像站在書架前替書換書腰，以前得先把整本書抽出來翻過才能改名，現在不用打開內頁就能直接寫上新名字。⟧
body.en: Several old records sit in the list, and you want to give one a clearer label without opening each one. Now you can select the target and enter `/rename` to rename that session directly without opening it first. ⟦Picture standing at a bookshelf to swap a book's belly band: before, you had to pull the whole book out and flip through it to change the name, whereas now you can write the new name right away without opening the pages.⟧

items.original: New `/rename` command on the dashboard renames the selected session without opening it

title.zh-TW: 新增 /models 指令從伺服器重抓模型清單
title.en: New /models command refreshes the model list from the server

body.zh-TW: 不確定畫面上顯示的模型還是不是最新一批，卻不想靠猜的。輸入 `/models`，就會直接向伺服器重新抓取目前可用的模型清單。⟦跟走到自動販賣機前按下更新鍵一樣，不用憑印象猜測，直接向倉庫抓回最新上架的品項清單。⟧
body.en: You are not sure whether the models shown on screen are still the latest batch, and you do not want to guess. Entering `/models` fetches the currently available model list directly from the server again. ⟦Think of walking up to a vending machine and pressing a refresh button: instead of guessing from memory, you pull the latest stocked item list straight from the warehouse.⟧

items.original: New `/models` command refreshes the available model list from the server

title.zh-TW: /hooks 清單改用清楚欄位顯示檔名與設定
title.en: /hooks list now shows file names and settings in clear fields

body.zh-TW: 查看自動化設定不用再對著原始指令硬猜用途。`/hooks` 清單每一列現在都會顯示 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）的檔案名稱。各項設定也改成在易讀的欄位裡列出，不再直接傾倒原始指令。⟦配電箱打開來，以前裡面只塞著一長串難懂的原始線路代號，現在每個開關旁都印好檔名跟設定項目。⟧
body.en: Checking your automation setup no longer means guessing what raw commands do. Each row in the `/hooks` list now displays the file name of the hook (a small program triggered by a specific event). Settings are also listed in readable fields instead of dumping raw commands. ⟦Open a breaker box: before, it was stuffed with a long string of cryptic raw wiring codes, and now each switch has its file name and settings printed right beside it.⟧

items.original: `/hooks` rows now show the hook file name and list settings in readable fields instead of dumping raw commands

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器檢視與開關設定更準確
title.en: More accurate MCP server inspection and toggle behavior

body.zh-TW:
調整或檢查 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，現在能看到更清楚的狀態與路徑。

在 `/mcps` 裡，除非裡頭超過十台伺服器，否則代管區塊預設會直接展開。

在已經執行的終端機介面工作階段裡，`grok mcp disable` 與 `grok mcp enable` 現在能正確停止對應的伺服器。

執行 `grok inspect` 檢查專案自訂的 MCP 伺服器時，回報的設定檔位置現在能正確對應到 `.grok/config.toml` 或 `.mcp.json`。

這樣一來，清單展開範圍、進行中工作階段的伺服器停用，以及設定檔路徑都跟實際狀態一致。
body.en:
When adjusting or checking MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers, you now see clearer statuses and paths.

In `/mcps`, hosted sections are now expanded by default unless they contain more than ten servers.

Inside already-running terminal UI sessions, `grok mcp disable` and `grok mcp enable` now properly stop the corresponding servers.

When running `grok inspect` on project-defined MCP servers, the reported config file location now accurately points to `.grok/config.toml` or `.mcp.json`.

As a result, list expansion scope, stopping servers in active sessions, and config file paths all match the actual state.

items.original:
`/mcps` now shows hosted sections expanded by default unless they contain more than ten servers
`grok mcp disable` (and enable) now correctly stops servers inside already-running TUI sessions
`grok inspect` now reports the correct project `.grok/config.toml` or `.mcp.json` file for project-defined MCP servers

title.zh-TW: /workflows 清單按 Enter 可直接開檔並搜尋
title.en: Pressing Enter in /workflows opens the file for viewing and searching

body.zh-TW: 平時對照工作流程定義，總得確認裡面的步驟寫法。現在游標停在 `/workflows` 清單的項目上按下 `Enter`，就會直接開啟該流程的檔案，方便你瀏覽與搜尋內容。
body.en: When reviewing workflow definitions, you often need to check how the steps are written. Now, pressing `Enter` on an item in the `/workflows` list opens that workflow's file directly so you can browse and search its contents.

items.original: Enter on a workflow in the `/workflows` list now opens its file for viewing and searching

title.zh-TW: 全展開模式重複收合思考時會提示關閉快捷鍵
title.en: Hint shows the toggle shortcut when repeatedly collapsing thoughts in expand-all mode

body.zh-TW: 每次回答一長串思考過程，你可能忍不住一塊一塊手動把它們摺起來，卻忘了全部展開模式還開著。在全部展開開啟的狀態下，只要你持續把思考段落一個個收起來，畫面就會跳出提示，列出用來關掉全部展開的組合鍵。⟦你一盞一盞手動關掉小燈，旁邊的人看你連按好幾顆，就會順手指給你看總開關的位置在哪。⟧
body.en: When a response includes a long chain of thought steps, you might find yourself folding them up one by one without realizing expand-all mode is still on. While expand-all is enabled, if you keep collapsing thought sections individually, a hint appears showing the key chord that turns expand-all off. ⟦As you switch off small lights one by one, someone watching you press several switches in a row points out where the master switch is.⟧

items.original: A new contextual hint appears when you keep collapsing thoughts while expand-all is on, showing the chord that turns it off

title.zh-TW: 問答卡打字與貼上回答不再誤觸快捷鍵或捲過頭
title.en: Typing and pasting on question cards no longer trigger shortcuts or overscroll

body.zh-TW:
在問答卡上想填寫自己的回答，以前操作常出狀況。現在打字或貼上回答內容，都不會再被誤認成快捷鍵。

打字輸入回答的過程中，問答卡清單也不會再捲超過最後一個選項。
body.en:
Entering your own answer on a question card used to run into input issues. Now, typing or pasting an answer is no longer misinterpreted as a shortcut.

While typing an answer, the question card list also no longer scrolls past the last option.

items.original:
Typed or pasted answers on question cards are no longer misinterpreted as shortcuts
Question card lists no longer scroll past the last option while typing an answer

title.zh-TW: 儀表板派送與快速檢視回覆框操作改進
title.en: Improved controls in dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes

body.zh-TW:
打字打一半想一口氣清掉剛敲錯的字詞，不用再連按倒退鍵。現在在儀表板的派送與快速檢視回覆框裡按 `Ctrl+W`，就能刪掉前一個單字。

當派送訊息正在等待圖片傳送時，快速檢視回覆框依然可以正常接收按鍵輸入與貼上內容。
body.en:
When you want to clear a mistyped word mid-sentence, you no longer need to tap backspace repeatedly. Pressing `Ctrl+W` in the dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes now deletes the previous word.

While a dispatch message is waiting on an image transfer, the peek reply box still accepts keystrokes and pasted content normally.

items.original:
Ctrl+W now deletes the previous word in the dashboard dispatch and peek reply boxes
Dashboard peek still accepts keys and pastes while a dispatch send waits on an image

title.zh-TW: 接續工作階段後背景任務與工作流程位置修正
title.en: Fixed placement of background tasks and workflows after resuming a session

body.zh-TW: 事情做到一半暫停，回頭重開紀錄繼續進行，裡頭有些項目常會插錯順序。這個問題已經修好，現在重開工作階段後，背景任務與工作流程都會出現在對話紀錄裡正確的順序位置。
body.en: When you paused halfway through a task and reopened the record to continue, some items would end up out of order. That issue is fixed: after resuming a session, background tasks and workflows now appear in the right order in the transcript.

items.original: Background tasks and workflows now appear in the correct place in the transcript after resuming a session

title.zh-TW: 搜尋與篩選列的選取錯位與語法錯誤提示修正
title.en: Fixed selection offset and syntax error message in search and filter bars

body.zh-TW:
在區塊檢視器裡用搜尋列找內容，以前容易點選到被搜尋列蓋住的那一行。現在搜尋列不會再誤選被它擋在底下的那行文字。

當輸入的 regex（正規表達式，用符號匹配字串的語法）格式無效時，搜尋列與篩選列現在會直接顯示 `bad pattern`。
body.en:
When searching in the block viewer, it used to be easy to select the line covered by the search bar. The search bar no longer mistakenly selects the line of text hidden underneath it.

When an invalid regex (regular expression, a syntax for matching strings with symbols) is entered, the search and filter bars now directly display `bad pattern`.

items.original:
Block viewer search bar no longer selects the line hidden under it
Search and filter bars now show `bad pattern` when the regex is invalid

title.zh-TW: 回覆中的無效連結改顯示為純文字
title.en: Dead links in replies now appear as plain text

body.zh-TW: 回覆裡有時會夾帶已經失效的連結，過去畫面還是把它畫成可點擊的超連結。現在回覆中的無效連結只會以純文字呈現，不會再顯示為可點擊的連結。
body.en: Replies sometimes include dead links, which the screen used to render as clickable hyperlinks. Now dead links in replies appear only as plain text rather than clickable links.

items.original: Dead links in replies now appear as plain text rather than clickable links

title.zh-TW: /goal pause 後的階段計時器改從零起算
title.en: Phase timers after /goal pause now start from zero

body.zh-TW: 使用 `/goal pause` 之後查看階段計時，過去畫面上會留著過時的舊時間。現在 `/goal pause` 後的階段計時器會從零開始計時，不再顯示殘留的舊時間。
body.en: When checking phase timing after using `/goal pause`, the screen used to keep showing stale time. Now phase timers after `/goal pause` start from zero and no longer display leftover old time.

items.original: Phase timers after `/goal pause` now start from zero instead of showing stale time

title.zh-TW: grok update 輸出不再夾帶內部代號與設定檔
title.en: grok update output no longer includes internal IDs or config files

body.zh-TW: 更新完工具想確認畫面訊息，以前總會混進幾行給研發端看的編號和檔名。現在 `grok update` 的輸出已經移除這些內部項目，不再顯示實驗 ID 或設定檔名稱。
body.en: When checking screen messages after updating the tool, a few lines of IDs and filenames meant for developers used to get mixed in. Now `grok update` has removed these internal items from its output and no longer displays experiment IDs or config file names.

items.original: `grok update` no longer mentions internal experiment IDs or config files in its output

title.zh-TW: 登入畫面貼上金鑰時不再點名環境變數
title.en: Sign-in screen no longer names an environment variable when pasting a key

body.zh-TW: 把存好的通行憑證複製進帳號驗證框，以前頁面還會順帶寫出一個系統參數的名字。現在當你可能貼上了已儲存的金鑰，登入畫面不再顯示環境變數名稱。
body.en: When copying a saved credential into the account verification box, the page used to also mention the name of a system parameter. Now when you may have pasted a saved key, the sign-in screen no longer displays an environment variable name.

items.original: Sign-in screen no longer names an environment variable when a saved key may have been pasted

title.zh-TW: 服務端連上卻不回傳時對話與壓縮不再卡死
title.en: Turns and compaction no longer hang when a provider connects without responding

body.zh-TW: 進行對話輪次或壓縮對話內容，萬一供應商雖然建立連線卻始終沒送回回應，以前畫面會就此卡住。這個問題已經修好，現在碰到供應商連上卻無回應時，輪次與對話壓縮都不會再卡死。
body.en: During conversation turns or content compaction, if a provider established a connection but never sent back a response, the screen used to freeze. This issue is now fixed, so when a provider connects without responding, neither turns nor conversation compaction will hang anymore.

items.original: Turns and compaction no longer hang when a provider connects but never sends a response

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器支援動態產生請求標頭
title.en: MCP servers support dynamic request headers

body.zh-TW: 連接外部工具，不想把請求標頭寫死在設定裡，可以交給指令動態提供。現在設定 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，可以指定 `headers_helper` 指令，由它提供動態請求標頭。
body.en: When connecting to external tools, you can let a command provide request headers dynamically instead of hardcoding them in the config. When configuring an MCP (a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) server, you can now specify a `headers_helper` command to supply dynamic request headers.

items.original: MCP servers can now specify a `headers_helper` command to provide dynamic request headers

title.zh-TW: 只有 Tab 鍵能切回暫置卡片與審核
title.en: Only Tab returns to parked cards and approvals

body.zh-TW:
把卡片暫時擱在一旁，或準備回到先前看到一半的計畫審核畫面時，按其他按鍵已經沒有反應。現在只有 `Tab` 鍵能切回暫置的卡片或計畫審核。

⟦以前書桌旁好幾個按鈕都能把暫存的文件夾叫回桌面，現在改只留一顆專屬呼叫鍵，要調閱擱置的資料只認這一顆。⟧
body.en:
Other keys no longer respond when you want to pull back a card you set aside or return to a plan approval screen you were reviewing. Now only the `Tab` key returns to a parked card or plan approval.

⟦Previously, several buttons by the desk could call a held folder back to the tabletop, but now only one dedicated call button remains for pulling up set-aside files.⟧

items.original: Tab is now the only key that returns to a parked card or plan approval

title.zh-TW: Windows 語音聽寫會指引開啟麥克風
title.en: Windows voice dictation points to microphone access

body.zh-TW: 想靠說話輸入文字卻沒反應，往往是作業系統擋下了收音權限。過去被系統攔截時只能自己摸索設定頁，現在畫面會直接告訴你要去哪裡打開麥克風存取權。
body.en: When speaking to enter text gets no response, the operating system has often blocked audio permissions. Previously you had to hunt through settings on your own when blocked by the system, but now the screen tells you directly where to turn on microphone access.

items.original: Voice dictation on Windows now tells you where to turn on microphone access when the OS blocks it

title.zh-TW: 啟動並行處理查詢讓第一畫面更快出現
title.en: Parallel startup queries speed up the first frame

body.zh-TW:
打開 Grok Build，等待第一個畫面出現的時間縮短了。現在啟動程式會一邊送出終端機協定查詢，一邊建立代理程式連線，不用等前一步做完，第一畫面就能更快出現。

用內嵌或精簡模式啟動時，遇到回應游標位置查詢特別慢的終端機，也不會再拖慢第一畫面的顯示速度。

⟦就像進餐廳點餐，以前一定要等服務生先抄完桌號才肯通知廚房開火；現在點菜跟廚房備料同步進行，第一道菜自然更快上桌。⟧
body.en:
Opening Grok Build now takes less time before the first frame appears. Startup now sends terminal protocol queries at the same time as it establishes the agent connection, so the first frame shows up faster without waiting for the prior step to finish.

When starting in inline or minimal mode, terminals that answer cursor position queries slowly no longer delay the first frame from appearing.

⟦Think of ordering at a restaurant: before, the kitchen would not fire up until the waiter finished writing down the table number, whereas now taking the order and prepping the food happen in parallel so the first dish arrives sooner.⟧

items.original:
Startup now overlaps terminal protocol queries with the agent connection for a faster first frame
Inline and minimal mode startup no longer delays the first frame on terminals that answer the cursor question slowly

title.zh-TW: 額度撞上限切換模型會寫明並套用設定
title.en: Limit-hit model switches show and apply exact settings

body.zh-TW:
對話聊到一半跳出用量上限通知，想按提示換一個模型繼續問，以前選項上看不出會套用哪組參數，切過去也不見得吻合建議值。

現在額度達到上限要切換模型時，按鈕會寫清楚即將選用的確切設定，例如 `Switch to Auto (Standard, Terse)`。確認從上限視窗切換後，也會直接套用後端建議的那一組設定。

⟦你搭計程車遇到管制改道時，以前司機只說換條路走卻沒講路線；現在導航會先亮出完整的新路線名稱，按下確認就照那條走。⟧
body.en:
When a usage limit notice pops up mid-conversation and you follow the prompt to switch models, the option used to hide which parameters would apply and switching did not always match the suggested values.

Now when switching models at a limit hit, the button spells out the exact settings it will select, such as `Switch to Auto (Standard, Terse)`. After confirming the switch from the limit box, it also directly applies the exact settings suggested by the backend.

⟦Picture taking a taxi during a road detour: before, the driver only said to take another way without naming the route, whereas now the navigation shows the full new route name upfront and follows it once you confirm.⟧

items.original:
Limit-box model switch now applies the exact settings the backend suggested
Limit-hit model switches now show the exact settings they will select (for example "Switch to Auto (Standard, Terse)")

title.zh-TW: 空白 hook 檔不報錯且保留首屏提示列
title.en: Empty hook files load cleanly and keep initial rows

body.zh-TW:
剛建立好 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）設定檔，裡面還沒寫規則、只留了空白，以前載入這類檔案會報錯。現在空的或只有空白字元的 hook 檔都能順利載入，不再出錯。

進到第一道提示詞畫面時，只要頁面空間還裝得下，先前的列例如 hook 備註就會留在畫面上，不會一進輸入就消失。
body.en:
When you just created a hook (a small program triggered by specific events) config file with no rules yet and only whitespace, loading it used to throw an error. Now empty or whitespace-only hook files load without error.

When entering the first prompt screen, earlier rows such as hook notes stay visible as long as they fit on the page, instead of disappearing as soon as you start entering input.

items.original:
An empty or whitespace-only hook file now loads without error
The first prompt now keeps earlier rows (such as hook notes) visible when they fit on the page

title.zh-TW: 載入舊工作階段保住模型設定且不卡回合
title.en: Loaded sessions keep model settings and no longer wait on ended turns

body.zh-TW:
打開先前存好的工作階段繼續作業，不用擔心剛打開時抓不到清單就蓋掉設定。就算第一次取得模型清單失敗，載入的工作階段仍會保留已儲存的模型與思考強度。

遇到已經結束的已儲存回合，終端機介面也不會再繼續空等。
body.en:
When you open a previously saved session to continue working, you no longer have to worry about losing settings if the list cannot be fetched right away. Even if the first model list fetch fails, loaded sessions still keep their saved model and effort.

When encountering a saved turn that has already ended, the terminal interface no longer waits idly on it.

items.original:
Loaded sessions now keep their saved model and effort even if the first model list fetch fails
The TUI no longer waits on a saved turn that has already ended

title.zh-TW: MCP 表單與網址拒絕卡片完整顯示內容
title.en: MCP form and URL rejection cards show full content

body.zh-TW:
精簡模式下的 MCP 表單卡片現在會貼合它所繪製的寬度，每個輸入欄位都能留在畫面上。

就算網址遭拒的錯誤原因長到換成兩行，MCP 網址拒絕卡片還是會把遭到拒絕的完整網址整個顯示出來。
body.en:
The MCP form card in minimal mode now fits the width it draws, keeping every input field visible on screen.

Even when the error reason for a rejected URL wraps to two rows, the MCP URL rejection card still displays the full rejected URL.

items.original:
The MCP form card in minimal mode now fits the width it draws, so every field stays visible
The MCP URL rejection card now shows the full rejected URL even when the error reason wraps to two rows

title.zh-TW: 角色設定的多行反白與標籤顯示修正
title.en: Persona multi-line highlights and badge display fixes

body.zh-TW:
打開 `/agents` 視窗調整角色設定，選到哪一行、還剩多少指令沒展開，現在一眼就分得出來。

選取角色設定裡的多行欄位時，每一行都會一併亮起反白。折疊起來的指令說明提示，現在也會顯示真正還剩下幾行。

切換到 `/agents` 視窗的 Personas 分頁後，徽章會依作用範圍區分顏色。如果工具或提示詞延伸欄位沒有內容，畫面會直接寫著 `(empty)`。

⟦就像整理資料夾時把整疊紙用螢光筆畫齊、再貼上分色標籤，以前要自己猜還剩幾頁或是不是空的，現在一眼就能看穿。⟧
body.en:
When you open the `/agents` modal to adjust persona settings, it is now clear at a glance which row is selected and how many instruction lines remain collapsed.

Selecting a multi-line field in a persona now highlights every row. The collapsed-instructions hint also displays the true remaining line count.

After switching to the Personas tab in the `/agents` modal, badges are colored by scope. If tool or prompt-extension fields have no content, the screen reads `(empty)`.

⟦Like tidying up a folder by highlighting a whole stack of pages evenly and adding color-coded tabs, you no longer have to guess how many pages are left or whether a section is blank.⟧

items.original:
Selecting a multi-line field in a persona now highlights every row, and the collapsed-instructions hint shows the true remaining line count
On the `/agents` modal the Personas tab now colors badges by scope, and empty tool or prompt-extension fields read (empty)

title.zh-TW: 窄視窗優先留住資料夾並截斷過長名稱
title.en: Narrow terminals preserve folder names and truncate long model or mode names

body.zh-TW:
終端機視窗拉窄，或選了名稱特別長的模型與模式，畫面頂端和輸入框很容易被字串撐爆。

現在輸入框邊框與模式橫幅遇到過長的模型或模式名稱時，會改用刪節號截斷收尾。

在窄終端機開啟歡迎列時，會先縮短分支名稱，優先保住目前所在的資料夾名稱不被擠掉。
body.en:
When the terminal window is narrowed or a model or mode has an especially long name, the top of the screen and the prompt box can easily overflow.

Now the prompt border and mode banner truncate overly long model or mode names with an ellipsis.

When opening the welcome bar on narrow terminals, the branch name is shortened first to keep the current folder name visible.

items.original:
Prompt border and mode banner now truncate long model or mode names with an ellipsis
Welcome bar on narrow terminals keeps the current folder name visible by shortening the branch first

title.zh-TW: 連結手型游標不閃跳與載入動畫提示
title.en: Steady Link Hand Pointer and Loading Indicator

body.zh-TW:
滑鼠停在連結上按 `Cmd`，或是等待檔案搜尋與圖片預覽跑出來，現在都能看到明確的游標與狀態回饋。

游標停在連結上方時，無論按下或放開 `Cmd` 鍵，都會持續維持手型指標。

搜尋檔案、開啟歷史紀錄和預覽圖片時，畫面上都會出現動態的 `Loading…` 提示。
body.en:
Hovering over a link while pressing `Cmd`, or waiting for file search and image previews to load, now gives you clear cursor and status feedback.

Links keep showing the hand pointer when `Cmd` is pressed or released while the pointer rests on them.

File search, history, and image preview now show an animated `Loading…` indicator.

items.original:
Links keep showing the hand pointer when Cmd is pressed or released while the pointer rests on them
File search, history and image preview now show an animated "Loading…" indicator

title.zh-TW: /doctor 與 /usage 顯示文字修正
title.en: Text Fixes for /doctor and /usage

body.zh-TW:
跑診斷檢查鍵盤設定或查看各模型花費了多少 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），兩個常用指令的文字輸出都已修正。

輸入 `/doctor` 檢查環境時，遇到已經確認過、但實際上並沒有啟用的鍵盤協定，現在會正確指出它並未投入使用。

查看 `/usage` 依模型分列的用量明細時，每列後方的計量文字統一改為小寫的 `tokens`，跟其他地方格式一致。

⟦水電帳單校對好之後就是這樣，以前錶頭沒在跑卻沒講實話、單位大小寫還各寫各的，現在狀態報得準、寫法也統一了。⟧
body.en:
When running diagnostics on your keyboard setup or checking how many tokens (the text units AI processes and bills by) each model used, the text output for both common commands is now fixed.

When you run `/doctor` to check your environment, it now correctly says when a confirmed keyboard protocol is not actually in use.

When viewing the `/usage` by-model breakdown, each row now uses lowercase `tokens` for consistency with the rest of the interface.

⟦A reconciled utility bill works the same way: before, it failed to admit when a meter was idle and mixed up unit capitalization, whereas now both the status and the wording are accurate and consistent.⟧

items.original:
`/doctor` now correctly says when a confirmed keyboard protocol is not actually in use
`/usage` by-model rows now say "tokens" in lowercase for consistency

title.zh-TW: Tasks 窗格排版與點選操作多項修復
title.en: Tasks Pane Layout and Selection Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在窄終端機開啟 Tasks 窗格挑任務來操作，以前畫面容易錯位，按鍵跟滑鼠也常常選錯對象。

現在按鈕和計時器不會再蓋到狀態圖示上。篩選後，每一列的圖示、時間跟按鈕也會老實待在各自那一列，不會跑版。

用鍵盤操作時，動作會直接套用到反白的那一列。把窗格往下捲動再點選，也會準確選中游標底下的任務。

搜尋列不會再莫名其妙消失，更新篩選條件後也不會殘留過時的舊列。點到搜尋列或篩選狀態列時，更不會誤選到被藏起來的任務。

⟦修好這塊面板就像把錯位的電梯按鍵板重新對齊，以前按鈕疊在一起、按這格卻跳去別層，現在指哪裡就穩穩點中哪裡。⟧
body.en:
Opening the Tasks pane on a narrow terminal to pick a task used to cause layout misalignment, and keyboard or mouse actions often hit the wrong item.

Buttons and timers no longer paint over the status icon. After filtering, each row's icon, time, and buttons stay on their own row without breaking layout.

Keyboard actions now apply directly to the highlighted row. Clicking after scrolling the pane down also accurately selects the task under the pointer.

The search bar no longer disappears unexpectedly, and updating a filter no longer leaves stale rows behind. Clicking the search bar or filter status row no longer selects a hidden task either.

⟦Realigning a crooked elevator button panel captures this fix: buttons once overlapped and pressing one slot sent you to a different floor, but now wherever you point, it reliably hits the right spot.⟧

items.original: Tasks pane on narrow terminals no longer paints buttons or timers over the status icon; filtering keeps each row's icon, time and buttons on its own row; keys act on the highlighted row; clicks in a scrolled pane select the task under the pointer; the pane no longer loses its search bar, shows stale rows after a filter update, or selects a hidden task when clicking the search or filter status row

title.zh-TW: /tasks 與 /queue 輸出及窗格導覽更新
title.en: /tasks and /queue Output and Pane Navigation Updates

body.zh-TW:
查看任務排程、待辦事項或指令佇列時，各個區塊的顯示格式與隱藏後的鍵盤切換都已補齊一致。

`/tasks` 區塊顯示排程迴圈時，現在會套用跟 Tasks 窗格相同的下次觸發後綴與空白狀態訊息。

todo、tasks 與 queue 這三個窗格就算在隱藏狀態下內容有變動，切回來後鍵盤方向鍵操作依然正常。

`/queue` 的輸出現在會在 bash 指令前面加上 `! ` 前綴，並改用跟窗格相同的行數後綴。
body.en:
When checking scheduled tasks, to-dos, or the command queue, display formatting across blocks and keyboard navigation after hiding a pane are now consistent.

The `/tasks` block now displays scheduled loops with the same next-fire suffix and empty-state message as the Tasks pane.

Even if the todo, tasks, and queue panes change while hidden, arrow-key navigation works properly once you switch back.

`/queue` output now prefixes bash commands with `! ` and uses the same line-count suffix as the pane.

items.original:
The `/tasks` block now shows scheduled loops with the same next-fire suffix and empty message as the Tasks pane
Keyboard navigation in todo, tasks and queue panes now works correctly after the pane changes while hidden
`/queue` output now prefixes bash commands with "! " and uses the pane's line-count suffix

title.zh-TW: 捲動紀錄與區塊檢視器的顯示與選取修復
title.en: Scrollback and Block Viewer Display and Selection Fixes

body.zh-TW:
往回捲動看先前的任務紀錄，或在區塊檢視器搜尋內文，現在每一行都能完整看清。

捲動紀錄現在會把相同的選取反白樣式套用到 Task、Subagent 與 Workflow 這幾類項目列上。

在窄終端機看捲動紀錄時，折行的文字內容跟分組標題也不會再無故漏掉。

開啟區塊檢視器搜尋內文時，搜尋列與狀態列不會再重疊遮住底部的內容行。
body.en:
When scrolling back through earlier task records or searching inside the block viewer, every line is now clearly visible.

Scrollback now applies the same selection highlight to Task, Subagent, and Workflow rows.

Scrollback on narrow terminals no longer drops wrapped text or group headers.

When searching inside the block viewer, the search bar and status bar no longer overlap the bottom lines of content.

items.original:
Scrollback now applies the same selection highlight to Task, Subagent and Workflow rows
Block viewer search bar and status no longer overlap the last lines of content
Scrollback on narrow terminals no longer drops wrapped text or group headers

title.zh-TW: 佈景主題邊框與提示文字的配色調整
title.en: Theme Border and Hint Text Color Adjustments

body.zh-TW:
不論你偏好深色還是淺色終端機配色，介面上的邊框、提示字與反白底色現在都搭得起來。

Tokyo Night 主題在輸入框未聚焦時，邊框現在會正確淡暗下來。

操作提示與已經回答過的問題文字，現在也會跟著終端機佈景主題一起調暗。

在淺色佈景主題下，歡迎畫面的項目列改用較淺的選取與滑鼠懸停顏色。
body.en:
Whether you prefer a dark or light terminal palette, borders, hint text, and highlight backgrounds now match cleanly.

The Tokyo Night theme now dims the unfocused input border correctly.

Tips and answered-question text now dim to match the terminal theme.

On light themes, welcome screen rows now use lighter selection and hover colors.

items.original:
Tokyo Night theme now dims the unfocused input border correctly
Tips and answered-question text now dim to match the terminal theme
Welcome screen rows on light themes now use lighter selection and hover colors

title.zh-TW: 主控面板指令開放與操作體驗更新
title.en: Dashboard Command Support and Interaction Updates

body.zh-TW:
主控面板開著的時候，查閱說明指令、辨識選項與貼上圖片都比以前直接。

現在主控面板處於啟用狀態時，直接輸入 `/release-notes`、`/docs` 與 `/help` 都能順利打開對應內容。

主控面板的預覽窗格在標記選中的權限或提問選項時，會改用跟其他畫面一樣的插入符號與底色帶。

主控面板的操作按鈕現在標為 `Resume Session` 與 `Enable Worktree`。自由輸入列則改顯示 `Type your answer here`。

在主控面板貼上圖片時，圖片會直接附著到正確的輸入欄位，不用再等其他欄位。
body.en:
While the dashboard is open, opening help commands, spotting selected options, and pasting images are all more direct.

When the dashboard is active, entering `/release-notes`, `/docs`, and `/help` now opens their corresponding content.

The dashboard peek pane now highlights the selected permission or question option with the same caret and band used elsewhere.

Dashboard action buttons are now labeled `Resume Session` and `Enable Worktree`. The free-text row now says `Type your answer here`.

Pasted images on the dashboard now attach directly to the correct input field without waiting for other fields.

items.original:
`/release-notes`, `/docs` and `/help` now open when the dashboard is active
The dashboard peek now highlights the selected permission or question option with the same caret and band used elsewhere
Dashboard now labels actions "Resume Session" and "Enable Worktree", and the free-text row says "Type your answer here"
Pasted images now attach to the correct input field on the dashboard without waiting for other fields

title.zh-TW: /resume 與工作階段選擇器排版與防誤觸
title.en: /resume and Session Picker Layout and Accidental-Input Fixes

body.zh-TW:
搜尋並切回先前的工作階段，在窄終端機或精簡模式下常會碰到顯示遮擋或選錯列的問題。

在窄終端機打開 `/resume` 搜尋列時，篩選條件標籤不會再蓋住你打的搜尋字，寬度足夠時也會秀出目前啟用的來源篩選器。

精簡模式的 `/resume` 現在只讓方向鍵與 Enter 作用於實際顯示的列，並套用跟完整選擇器一樣的載入轉圈圖示與空白狀態。它會用跟按鍵一致的查詢條件保留訊息文字相符的結果，關掉工作階段分組時則改畫平面清單，讓選取位置跟按鍵對得上。

工作階段的目前資料夾路徑在窄寬度折行時，`/resume` 面板依然會顯示所有欄位。如果過長的工作目錄路徑前段帶有空白字元，`/resume` 跟全螢幕選擇器也不會再截斷卡片。

清單還在重新載入期間，工作階段選擇器不會再讓按鍵或點擊觸發選取。在下一幀畫面實際繪製出清單列之前，按鍵也不會有反應。
body.en:
Searching for and switching back to a previous session on narrow terminals or in minimal mode often ran into obscured text or wrong-row selection.

On narrow terminals, the `/resume` search bar no longer lets the filter chip cover your query text, and it shows which source filter is active when width permits.

In minimal mode, `/resume` now lets arrow keys and Enter act only on rows that are actually shown, and uses the same loading spinner and empty states as the full picker. It keeps message-text matches visible using the same query the keys use, and draws a flat list when session grouping is off so selection lines up with key presses.

The `/resume` panel now shows all fields even when a session's current folder path wraps at narrow widths. If a long working directory path contains an early space, `/resume` and full-screen pickers no longer truncate cards.

While the list is still reloading, the session picker no longer lets key presses or clicks trigger a selection. Keys also do nothing until the next frame actually draws the list rows.

items.original:
`/resume` search bar on narrow terminals no longer lets the filter chip cover the query text, and now shows which source filter is active when width permits
`/resume` in minimal mode now lets arrow keys and Enter act only on rows that are actually shown, shows the same loading spinner and empty states as the full picker, keeps message-text matches visible using the same query the keys use, and draws a flat list when session grouping is off so selection matches the keys
`/resume` panel now shows all fields even when a session's CWD wraps at narrow widths, and `/resume` and full-screen pickers no longer truncate cards when a long CWD contains an early space
Session picker no longer lets keys or clicks act on sessions while reloading the list, and keys now do nothing until the next frame actually draws list rows

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式登入與互動提示畫面修復
title.en: Minimal Mode Sign-In and Prompt Screen Fixes

body.zh-TW:
在精簡模式登入帳號、確認信任或拒絕計畫修改，原本容易卡住或對不齊的訊息都已整理好。

媒體列移除精簡模式下點不了的 `[Open]` 按鈕，狀態與資訊列結尾改加上刪節號，逐字稿進度也改用句首大寫。

拒絕修改計畫時，精簡模式現在會直接顯示拒絕訊息，不再讓審核卡在空白狀態。

精簡模式登入失敗時只會用紅字顯示錯誤訊息，裝置代碼會單獨顯示並把說明放在下方，在得知登入流程前先寫 `Connecting…`，在窄終端機上也能整齊換行。

信任詢問提示裡的 `y/n` 後方，現在改為單一空白間隔。
body.en:
Signing in, confirming trust, or refusing a plan revision in minimal mode used to leave messages stuck or misaligned, and those are now cleaned up.

Media rows no longer show the `[Open]` button that cannot be clicked in minimal mode, status and info rows now end with an ellipsis, and transcript progress uses sentence case.

When refusing a plan revision, minimal mode now displays the refusal message directly instead of leaving the review stuck in a blank state.

On sign-in failure in minimal mode, only the error message appears in red; the device code is shown on its own with the caption underneath, `Connecting…` is shown until the flow type is known, and text wraps cleanly on narrow terminals.

In the trust prompt, `y/n` is now followed by single spacing.

items.original:
Minimal mode no longer shows an [Open] button on media rows, which that mode cannot click, and status and info rows now end in an ellipsis; transcript progress uses sentence case
Plan revise refusals now appear in minimal mode instead of leaving the review stuck with no message
Sign-in in minimal mode now shows only the error message in red on failure, shows the device code by itself with the caption underneath, shows "Connecting…" until the flow type is known, and wraps cleanly on narrow terminals
Trust question keys in minimal mode now read with single spacing after y/n

title.zh-TW: 權限與提問卡片的箭頭與捲軸修正
title.en: Permission and Question Card Arrow and Scrollbar Fixes

body.zh-TW:
遇到需要授權或回答選擇題的卡片，按鍵方向指示、長輸入文字跟右側捲軸現在都會對得剛剛好。

權限與提問卡片在窄終端機顯示過長的手打回答或表單值時，結尾會改用刪節號收尾。

權限卡片現在只會亮出還能繼續切換範圍的方向箭頭。下方的快捷鍵列也會精準對齊上面那張權限卡片列出的範圍箭頭。

提問卡片的選項說明依卡片寬度折行後，捲軸尺寸會跟著正確計算。如果所有選項一頁就裝得下，選項清單就不再顯示捲軸，也不會讓畫面過度捲動。
body.en:
On permission and question cards, key direction indicators, long typed text, and the right-hand scrollbar now line up properly.

On narrow terminals, permission and question cards now end long typed answers and form values with an ellipsis.

Permission cards now show only the scope arrows that can still move the scope. The shortcuts bar below also aligns precisely with the scope arrows listed on the permission card above it.

In question cards, scrollbar size is now calculated accurately after option descriptions wrap to the card width. When every option fits on one page, the option list no longer shows a scrollbar or allows overscroll.

items.original:
Permission and question cards now end long typed answers and form values with an ellipsis on narrow terminals
Permission cards now show only the scope arrows that still move the scope
The shortcuts bar now shows exactly the scope arrows the permission card above it names
Scrollbars in question cards now size correctly when option descriptions wrap to the card width
Question option lists no longer show a scrollbar or allow overscroll when every option fits

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式 /mcps 補上搜尋與操作提示
title.en: Minimal mode /mcps adds search and action hints

body.zh-TW:
習慣開精簡畫面工作的人，想管理 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）連線不再少一截。打開 `/mcps` 後，載入畫面、錯誤訊息與排版樣式都跟完整檢視一樣。

裡面還多了搜尋列和完整的按鍵操作提示。看到想操作的項目，按下對應按鍵就能直接打開表單。⟦隨身小遙控器現在補齊到跟客廳主力機一樣，以前只塞得下幾個開關，如今搜尋鍵跟設定選單都能直接按出來。⟧
body.en:
If you prefer working in minimal mode, managing MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) connections is no longer cut short. Opening `/mcps` now shows the same loading state, error messages, and layout style as the full view.

It also adds a search bar and the full set of action hints.
